description: This source file defines UI components and formatting logic for nodes in a menu within a macOS application using SwiftUI. It includes structures for formatting node entries, displaying node information, icons, and visual elements specific to different node types and statuses.

classes.name: NodeMenuEntryFormatter
classes.description: A static utility structure providing methods to format and interpret NodeInfo objects for display in UI, including role indication, platform, version, and icon selection.

classes.name: NodeMenuRowView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single row for a node in a menu, including icon, name, status, version, and other details.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A small SwiftUI view rendering a stylized icon indicating an Android device.

classes.name: NodeMenuMultilineView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view showing a label and multi-line value, used for detailed node information.

methods.name: isGateway
methods.description: Checks if a NodeInfo entry represents a gateway node.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a NodeInfo entry is connected.

methods.name: primaryName
methods.description: Returns a display name for the node, preferring displayName, fallback to nodeId, and prefix with 'Gateway' if appropriate.

methods.name: summaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string describing the node, including name, role, IP, platform, version, and status.

methods.name: roleText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the connection role/status of the node.

methods.name: detailLeft
methods.description: Provides a concise detail string, including IP and role.

methods.name: headlineRight
methods.description: Returns optional platform info for display in the UI.

methods.name: detailRightVersion
methods.description: Returns formatted version info for display.

methods.name: platformText
methods.description: Generates a human-readable platform label based on entry properties.

methods.name: compactVersion
methods.description: Helper to trim and simplify version strings.

methods.name: shortVersionLabel
methods.description: Converts version strings to a shorter label, adding 'v' prefix if needed.

methods.name: versionLabels
methods.description: Builds a list of version labels for core and UI versions.

methods.name: resolveVersions
methods.description: Resolves core and UI versions from a NodeInfo, with fallback to legacy version string.

methods.name: isHeadlessPlatform
methods.description: Checks if a platform is headless (like Darwin, Linux, Windows).

methods.name: leadingSymbol
methods.description: Determines the icon symbol name for a node based on its type and device family/family.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Determines if the node is an Android device based on device family or platform properties.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Returns a system symbol name if available, with fallback.
